license_required.quote: no person except those exempted by sections 464-3 and 464-5 shall practice professional engineering, architecture, land surveying or landscape architecture in the State unless the person is duly licensed under this chapter.

issuing_authority.value: Board of Professional Engineers, Architects, Surveyors, and Landscape Architects
issuing_authority.quote: There shall be a state board of professional engineers, architects, surveyors, and landscape architects hereinafter called "the board".

name.value: Board of Professional Engineers, Architects, Surveyors, and Landscape Architects
name.quote: There shall be a state board of professional engineers, architects, surveyors, and landscape architects hereinafter called "the board".

type.quote: There shall be a state board of professional engineers, architects, surveyors, and landscape architects hereinafter called "the board". The board shall consist of fourteen members, including at least four professional engineers, three professional architects, two professional surveyors, two professional landscape architects, and three public members.

umbrella_agency.value: Department of Commerce and Consumer Affairs
umbrella_agency.quote: "Department" means the department of commerce and consumer affairs.

age_minimum.quote: Affirmation that the applicant is beyond the age of majority

moral_character_required.quote: No person shall be eligible for licensure as a professional engineer, architect, land surveyor, or landscape architect if the person does not possess a history of honesty, truthfulness, financial integrity, and fair dealing.

degree_required.value: Graduate of a school or college approved by the board with an engineering curriculum of four years or more (or master's degree in engineering, or other qualifying combinations)
degree_required.quote: The person is a graduate of a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing, and has completed an engineering curriculum of four years or more; has had four years of full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board

accrediting_body.quote: a graduate of a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing

degree_level.quote: is a graduate of a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing and has completed an engineering curriculum of four years or more

school_approval_basis.quote: a graduate of a school or college approved by the board as of satisfactory standing

credential_pegged.quote: has successfully passed a written examination, prescribed by the board and designed to test the person's knowledge, skill, and competency in the profession of engineering

required.quote: has had four years of full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, or part-time experience which the board finds to be the equivalent thereof

experience_source.quote: has had four years of full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board, or part-time experience which the board finds to be the equivalent thereof

duration.value: 3 to 12 years depending on education pathway
duration.quote: has had three years of full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board

kind.quote: full-time lawful experience in engineering work of a character satisfactory to the board

exams.name: Written examination in engineering
exams.notes: Board-prescribed written examination testing knowledge, skill, and competency in engineering; statute also refers to a fundamentals examination component.
exams.quote: has successfully passed a written examination, prescribed by the board and designed to test the person's knowledge, skill, and competency in the profession of engineering

interval_years.quote: Every license expires on April 30 of each even-numbered year following its issuance and becomes invalid after that date unless renewed.

required.quote: The board shall require continuing education to renew a license for architects effective as of the renewal date for a license expiring on April 30, 2008

available.quote: The person is the holder of an unexpired license issued to the person by any jurisdiction, domestic or foreign, in which the requirements for licensure at the time the person was first licensed are of a standard satisfactory to the board

requirements.value: Applicant must hold an unexpired license from any domestic or foreign jurisdiction where requirements at time of first licensure are satisfactory to the board; board may require written examination if in doubt about standards.
requirements.quote: provided that if the board is in doubt as to whether the standards are satisfactory, or as to whether the holder was required to fully comply with them, it shall require that the holder successfully pass a written examination, prescribed by the board and designed to test the holder's knowledge, skill, and competency in the profession of engineering

scope_protection.quote: no person except those exempted by sections 464-3 and 464-5 shall practice professional engineering, architecture, land surveying or landscape architecture in the State unless the person is duly licensed under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing or utilizing an unlicensed person where licensure is required

definition_quote.value: a person who holds oneself out as able to perform, or who does perform, any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or observation of construction or operation, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects, wherein the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned or involved, when such professional service requires the application of engineering principles and data.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional engineer" means a person who holds oneself out as able to perform, or who does perform, any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or observation of construction or operation, in connection with any public or private utilities, structures, buildings, machines, equipment, processes, works, or projects, wherein the safeguarding of life, health, or property is concerned or involved, when such professional service requires the application of engineering principles and data.

methods_authorized.quote: any professional service such as consultation, investigation, evaluation, planning, design, or observation of construction or operation

engineer_intern_certificate_available.quote: provided where the candidate is eligible to take only that part of the examination pertaining to engineering fundamentals the candidate shall pay the appropriate fee

responsible_charge_defined.quote: the person or persons connected with the corporation or copartnership directly in charge of the professional work is duly licensed.

seal_required_on_documents.quote: All plans, specifications, maps, and reports prepared by or under the supervision of a licensed engineer, architect, surveyor, or landscape architect shall be stamped with such seal or stamp when filed with public officials.

seal_document_types.quote: All plans, specifications, maps, and reports prepared by or under the supervision of a licensed engineer, architect, surveyor, or landscape architect shall be stamped with such seal or stamp when filed with public officials.

firm_practice_allowed.quote: A corporation or copartnership may engage in the practice of professional engineering, architecture, surveying, or landscape architecture in the State if the person or persons connected with the corporation or copartnership directly in charge of the professional work is duly licensed.

value: Officers or employees of the United States practicing solely in that capacity
Persons doing engineering work on property owned or exclusively controlled by themselves (where no public safety or health is involved)
Privately owned one-storied buildings/structures with estimated cost not exceeding $40,000

exemptions_from_licensure.quote: Persons practicing professional engineering, architecture, land surveying, or landscape architecture solely as officers or employees of the United States shall be exempted from the provisions of this chapter.

code_of_ethics_in_statute.quote: conduct or practice contrary to recognized standards of ethics for the licensed profession or vocation

multi_license_reporting_required.quote: Disclosure of similar licensure in any state or territory; Disclosure of disciplinary action by any state or territory against any license held by the applicant

board_engineering_disciplines_represente.quote: The board shall consist of fourteen members, including at least four professional engineers, three professional architects, two professional surveyors, two professional landscape architects, and three public members.

board_member_responsible_charge_years_re.quote: A member representing the profession shall have been engaged in the practice of the member's profession for at least five years immediately preceding the date of the member's appointment.
